title: Yeasty Chewy Uruguayan Pecan Bread
description: A traditional Uruguayan bread filled with the rich flavor of pecans, made with a yeasty dough that yields a chewy texture.
instructions: Combine warm water and yeast in a small bowl. Stir gently and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add sugar, melted butter, eggs, flour, and salt to the donabe vessel.
Mix the dough using a wooden spoon or a stand mixer until smooth.
Add pecan nuts and sesame seeds to the dough and mix until evenly distributed.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape into a round loaf.
Place the loaf in the preheated donabe vessel and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the loaf from the oven and let cool in the vessel for 10 minutes.
Transfer the loaf to a wire rack and let cool completely.
